note: Edge segments measured on the repo image with sub-pixel edge and ridge fitting along hand-placed search segments (no pixels of the photograph are stored here). The photograph (区大伟) is framed by a white border; the picture area is 1488 x 991 px (3:2), taken as uncropped, so the principal point is its centre. World lines are on the east wing of Teaching Block 1 (data/buildings/yihao.json): bay 5.25 m from the 31.5 m wing length on the Esri/OSM outline, ground-floor windows centred in the bays in the plane 0.45 m behind the wing front (y -0.75).
camera_model: pinhole with radial distortion k1; principal point fixed at the centre of the picture area; free position, yaw, pitch, roll, focal length, k1

z_bot.basis: ground-floor window sill 0.80 m above the building floor (z 1.05, estimated); the camera height and every height in the solution move with this value

m.desc: offset of the outer mullions from the window centre (m)

w.desc: outer frame width of the ground-floor windows (m)

z_top.desc: height of the ground-floor window heads (twin z)

z_tr.desc: height of the transom bars (twin z)

tower_y.desc: y of the vertical edge read as the east tower corner
